question: W and X together can complete a work in 40 days. X and Y together can complete the same work in 60 days. If W, X and Y all work together, then the same work gets completed in 30 days. How many days will W and Y together take to complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

W and X together can complete a work in 40 days.

X and Y together can complete the same work in 60 days.

W, X, and Y all work together and complete the work in 30 days.

**Concept:**

Work done by W and X in 1 day = 1/40

Work done by X and Y in 1 day = 1/60

Work done by W, X, and Y in 1 day = 1/30

⇒ X + Y = 1/60

⇒ W + X + Y = 1/30
